name: video-script
description: Write the script for any video before anything is generated: what is said, shown and heard in every beat, sized to the clock and the video model. A brief and a facts file in; one script table out (time, spoken line, on-screen text, visual, sound), three hooks, and a check that measures pace, hook timing, shot length, unsourced numbers and AI-sounding lines. Six structures with one example script each, plus variations for demo and launch videos, product reviews, ads and UGC, social shorts and short-form drama, and a loop for testing and improving the skill. Use for "write a script", "video script", "ad script", "UGC script", "TikTok, Reels or Shorts script", "YouTube script", "voiceover script", "demo or launch video script", "product review script", "short drama episode", "skit", "hooks", "how many words for 30 seconds", or any video that has no script yet. Not for the look (find-references) or the shot prompts (varg-video-prompting).
